Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Harkesh Manuja
Present: Mr. S.S. Sahu, Advocate,
 for the petitioner.

This is an application for preponing the date of hearing in the main petition,
which is fixed for 12.05.2025.
Notice of the application.
Mr. P.K. Longia, DAG, Haryana, accepts notice on behalf of the respondents-State and raises no objection to the aforesaid course.

Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the contents of the application, same is allowed and the date of hearing of the main petition is preponed from 12.05.2025 to today itself i.e. 09.01.2025. CM-20611-CII-2024
This is an application for disposal of the main petition.

sentences.text: Having heard learned counsel for the parties and considering the contents of the application, same is allowed. CWP-1814-2024 1.

By way of present petition filed under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India, prayer has been made for issuance of direction to the respondents to grant exemplary damages and mense profit to the petitioners or to grant the compensation on account of possession of their respective land.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the present petition has been rendered infructuous as notification under Section 11 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, has already been issued on 30.10.2024.
3. In view of the above, the present petition is dismissed as having been rendered infructuous.
